title: Design System: It's A Wrap Admin CMS

display.purpose: Dashboard stat values and the largest number on a screen.

headline.purpose: Section titles, modal titles, empty-state titles, page h1s.

body.purpose: Table cell content and form input text.

label.purpose: Uppercase table column headers and stat labels.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Modal card floating over its backdrop — the strongest shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition for hovers, focus rings, and sidebar collapse.

components.name: Primary Button (Terracotta)
components.description: The single primary action on a screen — gradient fill with a colored glow shadow that brightens and lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.875rem 1.75rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: #ffffff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c4704f 0%, #e89a7a 100%); border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(196,112,79,0.25); transition: all 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(196,112,79,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c4704f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button (Forest)
components.description: Second-priority action color — same shape and lift behavior as the terracotta primary, forest gradient and glow instead.
components.css: .ds-btn-forest { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.875rem 1.75rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: #ffffff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a3a2f 0%, #2d5a47 100%); border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(26,58,47,0.25); transition: all 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-forest:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(26,58,47,0.35); } .ds-btn-forest:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1a3a2f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Flat, quiet, no shadow — for the non-primary action next to a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.875rem 1.75rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: #2c2c2c; background: #faf8f5; border: 1px solid #f0ebe3; border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f0ebe3; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c9a8a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Cream-filled at rest, turns white with a sage focus ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.875rem 1rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #2c2c2c; background: #faf8f5; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.75rem; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b6b6b; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; background: #ffffff; border-color: #7c9a8a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(124,154,138,0.15); }

components.name: Section Card
components.description: The default white content card with a terracotta accent bar next to its title.

components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 1.25rem; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); border: 1px solid #f0ebe3; } .ds-card-header { padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0ebe3; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Fraunces', serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; color: #2c2c2c; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-card-title::before { content: ''; width: 3px; height: 1.25rem; background: #c4704f; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.5rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #2c2c2c; }

components.name: Role Badge
components.description: Pill-shaped status badge; admin gets the forest gradient, user gets a flat cream outline.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem; border-radius: 2rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-admin { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a3a2f 0%, #2d5a47 100%); color: #ffffff; } .ds-badge-user { background: #faf8f5; color: #6b6b6b; border: 1px solid #f0ebe3; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Link
components.description: Sage-light at rest, white and pill-highlighted when active, on the forest-gradient sidebar.

narrative.overview:
The admin CMS reads like a farmhouse ledger, not a generic SaaS dashboard: deep forest green anchors the frame, sage sits quietly in the middle distance, and burnt terracotta is the one warm spark reserved for the action that matters on a given screen. Cream is the resting canvas everything else sits on. The voice is warm and grounded — unhurried, tactile, earthy — built for a single remote owner checking in on their shop, not for a crowded operations floor.

Fraunces (serif, optical sizing on) carries every title, stat value, and modal heading; DM Sans carries everything the owner actually reads and scans — table rows, labels, form fields, meta text. A subtle fractal-noise texture sits under every gradient header block at very low opacity, giving the forest-gradient panels a papery, non-digital grain instead of a flat corporate wash.
keyCharacteristics: Deep forest green as the trusted, structural anchor color (headers, sidebar, admin badges)
Sage as the quiet secondary — icon fills, hover accents, meta text on dark grounds
Burnt terracotta rationed to the single primary action per view
Cream as the near-universal background; white reserved for cards and focused inputs
Fraunces for display/title moments only; DM Sans owns all reading and data
A faint fractal-noise grain (0.04–0.08 opacity) on every gradient header block

rules.name: The One Spark Rule
rules.body: Burnt terracotta is the primary-action color for exactly one thing per screen — the single most important button or link. It never becomes a background fill or a secondary accent; when a screen needs two levels of emphasis, the second one is forest green (.btn-primary.btn-forest), not a second use of terracotta.

rules.name: The Serif-Is-a-Signal Rule
rules.body: Fraunces only ever marks a title, a heading, or a headline number. If DM Sans would read fine there, it belongs in DM Sans — Fraunces is reserved for the handful of moments per screen that deserve the extra weight.

rules.name: The Escalating Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadow intensity tracks how much a surface is asking of the owner: near-flat for anything they're just reading, strongest for anything blocking (a modal) or anything they're being asked to click (the one primary action).

dos: Do reserve burnt terracotta for the single primary action per screen; use the forest variant for a second-priority action instead of a second terracotta button.
Do use Fraunces exclusively for titles, headings, and headline-scale numbers; keep every table cell, form field, label, and meta string in DM Sans.
Do keep the fractal-noise overlay under gradient header blocks at 0.04–0.08 opacity — it should read as grain, not texture.
Do let shadow strength communicate stakes: near-flat for resting content, strongest for modals, colored-glow for the one primary action.
Do stay within the established radius scale (0.5rem through 1.5rem, plus pill and circle) rather than introducing new corner values.
donts: Don't use burnt terracotta as a background fill or for more than one control per view.
Don't add heavy shadows to resting/list surfaces (tables, list rows) — that strength is reserved for the modal tier.
Don't use the error red palette for anything other than destructive actions and validation states.
Don't introduce a vertical table border or heavier row dividers — separation stays horizontal and low-contrast.
